title: Will the call start on time?
hook: You booked the task's ten minutes of work, then the call.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: Include setup duration rather than just execution time.

objective: Include setup duration rather than just execution time.

claims.text: Scenario and prediction: You booked the task's ten minutes of work, then the call. The call is booked for 10. What is happening at 10? Correct option: The task has 5 min left. All fixture labels and durations are stipulated exercise data.
claims.source: Fixture rows in studyCatalog.ts: task 0–15 (setup 5, work 10), call at 10. Content patch r9 batch D (cm-lifehacks, company/reviews/lifehacks-200/content-patch-r9-batch-d.md block 11), applied by demo-builder for W-608 (2026-10-14).
claims.note: FC W-740 (2026-10-14): Task bar 0-15 (setup 5 + work 10); call at 10 → 5 min of the task remain. Stipulated data.

claims.text: The task is five minutes of setup plus ten of work. Booking only the ten leaves the call starting while five minutes remain.
claims.source: Principle field; fixture rows in studyCatalog.ts. Content patch r9 batch D (cm-lifehacks, company/reviews/lifehacks-200/content-patch-r9-batch-d.md block 11), applied by demo-builder for W-608 (2026-10-14).
claims.note: FC W-740 (2026-10-14): Same fixture: 5 + 10 = 15; booking 10 leaves 5 min overlapping the call.

claims.text: Every displayed result is computed from the visible exercise state: schedule. Exercise only; no measured productivity gain. The reveal reports this same state and never translates its score into a personal productivity or memory benefit.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/studyModels.ts and src/components/lifehacks/StudyLesson.tsx, count-setup-in-the-block fixture in src/lib/lifehacks/studyCatalog.ts. Stage rules: finish=start+duration; overlap is pairwise intersection length; last finish=max finish; deadline spill=max(0,last finish-deadline). FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: The booking is warm-up plus printing: 10 + 20 = 30 min, 5 more than the slot. Counting only the printing gives the 5 min 'to spare'.
claims.source: Recall why; values stipulated in the question. Content patch r9 batch D (cm-lifehacks, company/reviews/lifehacks-200/content-patch-r9-batch-d.md block 11), applied by demo-builder for W-608 (2026-10-14).

claims.text: Task bar: setup 5 min, work 10 min. Booked for the task: 10 min (call clashes for 5 min) or 15 min (no clash).

recall.question: A print job prints for 20 min after a 10-min printer warm-up. Your slot is 25 min. Does it fit?
recall.why: The booking is warm-up plus printing: 10 + 20 = 30 min, 5 more than the slot. Counting only the printing gives the 5 min 'to spare'.
